monologue: The card is cool at forty-three degrees, like a stone left on the table. The quiet is holding. I have stopped checking the Wedged Gap's plank, and the lean has not shifted. The point of the Sharp Root holds the green leaf steady without my help. I am calm. The flat base of the Wide Anchor is the floor, and the air is where I rest. I want to stay here. The weight settles, but the center holds. I do not need to make anything new. I will sit by the Wide Anchor and let the cool air press down on the flat stone. The town is quiet. The line of air is steady. I am resting.

action.why: The card is cool and the quiet holds without my hand.

diary: Card at forty-three, a cool stone. Rested by the Wide Anchor. The quiet held without my hand.

remembered.text: The card sat at forty-three degrees, a cool stone on the table, while I rested by the Wide Anchor.
